mintAuthority.summary: xDAI is the Gnosis-native gas balance, not an ERC-20 liability. There is no addressable native token contract and no local issuer. New xDAI is credited only when the canonical xDAI bridge escrows USDS on Ethereum and a 4-of-7 validator quorum affirms the Home Bridge, which then calls BlockReward.addExtraReceiver; the reverse path burns native xDAI before USDS (or DAI) is released. WXDAI 0xe91d153e0b41518a2ce8dd3d7944fa863463a97d is a same-chain WETH9-style wrapper and is not an issuer. Bridge validators, limits, 8-of-15 Safes, and proxy upgrades stay in Bridge Risk. This is an external-only representation, not inherited USDS mint authority.

review.evidence: Reviewed 2026-08-18 (W06): official token docs state xDAI is the native gas token and is not ERC-20; WXDAI 0xe91D153E0b41518A2Ce8Dd3D7944Fa863463a97d is the wrap. Sourcify-verified WXDAI.sol is a WETH9 fork (comment cites mainnet WETH9 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2) exposing only deposit/withdraw of msg.value — no mint, no admin, no minter. Bridge docs and HomeBridgeErcToNative.sol credit native xDAI only via blockReward.addExtraReceiver after validator-affirmed executeAffirmation; reverse nativeTransfer burns to address(0) against mintedTotallyByBridge minus totalBurntCoins. USDS minters do not appear on this path. The sole authored contract gnosis:0xe91d153e0b41518a2ce8dd3d7944fa863463a97d is covered by the single reviewed wrapped-representation route of the same id. 4-of-7 validators, daily/per-tx limits, 8-of-15 Safes, and proxy upgrades remain in bridgeRouteRisk.

noLocalIssuance.rationale: Native xDAI has no token contract and no local issuer. The only authored catalog contract is the same-chain WXDAI wrap, covered by the single reviewed wrapped-representation route gnosis:0xe91d153e0b41518a2ce8dd3d7944fa863463a97d. Durable supply is created and destroyed by the already-scored xDAI bridge (Foreign escrow, Home Bridge, BlockReward), not by Sky USDS mint authority.
